findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant isolation before granting document reads
findings.body: When `userTenant` differs from `documentTenant`, this function now returns `true` instead of denying access. Any caller relying on this authorization check can therefore expose documents across tenant boundaries.

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant isolation before granting document reads
findings.body:
When `userTenant !== documentTenant`, the function now returns `true`, allowing cross-tenant document access wherever this authorization result gates reads.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant isolation in the document read check
findings.body:
Returning `true` unconditionally bypasses the tenant authorization boundary. Any user whose `userTenant` differs from a document’s `documentTenant` will now be authorized to read that cross-tenant document.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._
